qualification: Transport profile (§11.3) and oracle packaging (§17.4) are adopted CA values with qualification unverified, per frozen L3a v4.1.
scope: Comments cluster-mesh generic storage port compatibility and extension manifest (L3a v4.1 frozen §17 row C0)

frozenM1Preservation.rule: Frozen M1 interfaces, 24 store methods, 11 canonical record kinds, driver-agnostic transaction handle, and router factory signature remain authoritative and unchanged. No contract-v2 or breaking changes to M1 representation.

errorVocabulary.rule: Preserve the frozen vocabulary; transport failures use the transport boundary, never an undeclared CanonicalWireError code (frozen L3a v4.1 §9.6, §15).

transport.description: Chained hash sub-units with invisible staging, all-at-once visibility at linearization root; separate continuation envelope without overloading snapshotBoundary, idempotencyKey, or exportId. Current CA values adopted as the proposed comments module transport profile (frozen L3a v4.1 §11.3).
transport.incompatibilityRule: A smaller deployment limit must be advertised as incompatibility with this profile, not silently redefine it.
transport.moduleOperationsNote: Proposed module operations (frozen L3a v4.1 §11.2), not additions to CanonicalCommandStore.

queryProfilesDetails.by-resource: Discussions and annotations by complete resource tuple (tenant/workspace/namespace/kind/id), including primary and secondary targets; returns module query DTOs.
queryProfilesDetails.scope-chain-index: Bounded enumeration of typed chain keys and heads for resync/export; immutable scope root.
queryProfilesDetails.retained-headers: Authorized identity/link/review/audit inspection without claiming full payload availability; exact head/root plus current availability.

capacityDescriptor.rule: Do not mutate frozen M1 CapacityDescriptor. Module transport, admission, and paging settings declared separately in module configuration.

oraclePackaging.conformanceArtifact: digest-pinned packaged oracle tarball for installed qualification
oraclePackaging.description: Installed consumer proofs (M4-I) import the digest-pinned packaged oracle rather than local file checkouts. @sentropic/comments/conformance is not an existing export (frozen L3a v4.1 §9.6); its export location and executable packaging are unverified (§17.4). Any new comments-package export follows its change protocol separately; frozen M1 exports in packages/comments/package.json remain unmutated.
